notes: Body replayed: v_add_nc_u32 v5, 1, v4; v_mov_b32 v6, 0xbad; s_cmp_eq_u32 s0, s0; s_cbranch_scc0 (x2). s_cmp of s0 with itself always sets SCC=1 so both branches (targets outside the body) are never taken, whatever s0 holds; the checker's 'branch outside' flags are expected.

Only column 0 (v5 = Input+1, stored before the program end) is comparable. Column 1 is asserted == 0xdeadbeef (nothing is stored past the end); that is a store/program-end property the oracle cannot observe, so it is not mapped.
Coverage is trivial: the test's subject (stores after the end instruction never happen) is not replayed.

Words 5-14 (s_nop, s_atc_probe, s_atc_probe_buffer, s_dcache_discard/_x2 [gfx1013-only encodings, not executable on gfx1036], s_round_mode 0) are excluded; s_round_mode 0 selects round-to-nearest for f32/f64, which equals the oracle's round32 = round16 = 0 and the body has no float ops.
Input row: Fill() sets dword 0 = tid*0x01010101+7, others 0; offen load with v1 = tid*16.
verified: disassembly (llvm-mc gfx1030) of the whole kernel; Run()/Check() read.
